title: Seedream 5.0 Pro vs GPT Image 2.5: Tested (2026)
summary: Seedream 5.0 Pro vs GPT Image 2.5: six same-prompt tests on Flick, from a film still to Japanese signs, a comic page and a storyboard, plus prices. Try both.
body_markdown:
### Is Seedream 5.0 Pro better than GPT Image 2.5?


Neither won outright in our six tests. Both spelled English titles, comic balloons and storyboard labels correctly; GPT Image 2.5 kept an accent Seedream 5.0 Pro dropped and costs less, while Seedream 5.0 Pro returned larger images with a fuller, painted look.


### Which is cheaper, Seedream 5.0 Pro or GPT Image 2.5?


GPT Image 2.5, at default settings in Flick: 5 credits an image against 14 for Seedream 5.0 Pro. At their top settings they cost the same: 28 credits for GPT Image 2.5 at 4K and high Prompt Weight, and 28 for Seedream 5.0 Pro at 2K.


### Can Seedream 5.0 Pro write Japanese text?


Yes, in our test it wrote "夜明けの喫茶店" and "500円" correctly on a café sign and chalkboard. ByteDance says Seedream 5.0 Pro handles over ten languages natively; we tested Japanese and English.


### Can GPT Image 2.5 make comic pages with speech balloons?


Yes. Given six panels and three quoted lines, GPT Image 2.5 drew a six-panel page with each line in the right panel and spelled correctly, though it also added three slogans the prompt did not ask for.


### How many reference images do Seedream 5.0 Pro and GPT Image 2.5 take?


Both take up to 10 reference images on Flick's image node. In the edit node, Seedream 5.0 Pro reads references by name when the prompt calls them Figure 1, Figure 2 and so on.


### Can I use Seedream 5.0 Pro and GPT Image 2.5 for free?


Both are on Flick's Free plan, and each image uses credits. Flick gives you 100 credits when you sign up and 200 more for joining the Flick Discord.
